CustomObject.description: Sends the confirmation mail of a campaign answer (Call me, Offer, Not now) outside the user's own context: the subscriber runs as the Automated Process user, so the Customer Hub guest never sends email itself. Published after commit by Svc_CampaignResponse (Util_CampaignConfirmationPublisher); handled by Svc_CampaignConfirmation.
CustomObject.label: Campaign Confirmation
